title: Genetic exploration of Dravet syndrome: two case report.
ehr_evidence: Whole genome sequencing (WGS), whole exome sequencing (WES), and Sanger sequencing were performed at 3Billion (Seoul, Korea).
summary: Case series of two Indonesian children with Dravet syndrome, detailing clinical presentations, genetic findings via NGS, and treatment outcomes.
key_findings: Patient 1 (n=1) had a 552.9 Kb heterozygous deletion spanning TTC21B, SCN1A, and SCN9A, experiencing 6-7 seizures per day.
Patient 2 (n=1) had a heterozygous splice site mutation in SCN1A (c.4003-2A>G), with seizures reduced to one per year after medication adjustment.
Greater genetic mutation severity correlated with more severe clinical manifestations and poorer seizure control (n=2).
data_source_type: clinical case series and genetic testing
population: two Indonesian children (aged 11 years 2 months and 1 year 4 months) with Javanese ethnicity
limitations: lack of parental genetic testing for inheritance confirmation
